title: Technology in Everyday Life: Five Words for the Digital Age

words.exam_focus_zh: 写作 Task 2 谈技术、能源时的高分动词；阅读中常与 exploit、make use of、tap into 构成同义替换。

senses.definition_zh: 利用（某种资源、力量或技术）以取得好处
senses.definition_en: to control and use the power or potential of something in order to achieve a particular result

senses.definition_zh: 马具，挽具；安全带、保护带
senses.definition_en: a set of straps used to control a horse or to fasten a person to something

synonyms.nuance_zh: 与 harness 接近，但常带“为自己获利”甚至“剥削”的意味，用于资源、机会、劳动力。
synonyms.collocation: exploit natural resources（开发自然资源）

synonyms.nuance_zh: 比 harness 更中性、更正式，只强调“加以使用”，不含“驾驭力量”的比喻色彩。
synonyms.collocation: utilise existing data（利用现有数据）

examples.sentence: Rather than treating automation as a threat, employers could harness it to free staff from repetitive tasks.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主与其把自动化视为威胁，不如利用它把员工从重复性工作中解放出来。
examples.note_zh: 写作 Task 2 高分句型：Rather than treating X as a threat, ... could harness it to do ...。

examples.sentence: Early farmers learned to harness the seasonal floods to irrigate their fields.
examples.translation_zh: 早期农民学会了利用季节性洪水灌溉田地。
examples.note_zh: 阅读中 harness 常接自然力（floods, wind, sunlight），可替换 make use of。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读中讨论技术更替、就业变化时常出现，常与 out of date、no longer used 同义替换；拼写易错（-ete 结尾）。

senses.definition_zh: 过时的，不再使用的，被淘汰的
senses.definition_en: no longer used or useful because something newer has been invented or developed

synonyms.nuance_zh: 更口语、更通用，可指观念、设备、信息；比 obsolete 语气轻，不一定“完全弃用”。

synonyms.definition_zh: 陈旧的，（观念、方法）不合时宜的
synonyms.nuance_zh: 更正式，多形容做法、观念、制度，少见用于具体机器。
synonyms.collocation: outmoded working practices（陈旧的工作方式）

word_forms.meaning_zh: 过时，淘汰（常指产品被 newer models 取代）

examples.sentence: Within a decade, the software had become obsolete and was no longer supported by its developers.
examples.translation_zh: 不到十年，这款软件就已过时，开发者也不再提供支持。
examples.note_zh: become obsolete 是听力与阅读里的固定搭配，注意与 obsolete 连用的时态变化。

examples.sentence: Some economists argue that automation does not simply render jobs obsolete but changes the skills they require.
examples.translation_zh: 一些经济学家认为，自动化并不只是让工作被淘汰，而是改变了这些工作所需的技能。
examples.note_zh: render sth obsolete 为写作高分结构，注意 render 后接宾语再接形容词。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读中描述数量迅速增长时的替换词（increase rapidly、mushroom）；其名词 proliferation 在写作趋势描述中很常用。

senses.definition_zh: 激增，迅速增多；（生物）迅速繁殖
senses.definition_en: to increase rapidly in number or amount; to reproduce quickly

synonyms.definition_zh: 迅速增多，雨后春笋般涌现
synonyms.nuance_zh: 更形象、略口语，多用于新闻报道式描述，正式论文中不如 proliferate 稳妥。
synonyms.collocation: mushroom into a major industry（迅速发展成一大产业）

synonyms.nuance_zh: 中性，既可指数目成倍增长，也可指生物繁殖，语气不如 proliferate 强调“数量之多”。

examples.sentence: Online learning platforms have proliferated in recent years, offering courses to students who cannot attend campus.
examples.translation_zh: 近年来在线学习平台激增，为无法到校上课的学生提供课程。
examples.note_zh: 现在完成时 + proliferate 是描述近年趋势的常用组合，可替换 have increased rapidly。

examples.sentence: The proliferation of cheap sensors has made it possible to monitor air quality street by street.
examples.translation_zh: 廉价传感器的普及使逐条街道监测空气质量成为可能。
examples.note_zh: The proliferation of X has made it possible to ... 是阅读与写作中常见的因果句式。

words.exam_focus_zh: 听力 Section 3/4 谈流程改进、企业管理时的高频动词；写作建议段中常用来替代 make ... simpler and faster。

senses.definition_zh: 简化（流程、机构）以提高效率
senses.definition_en: to make a process or organization simpler and more efficient by removing unnecessary parts
to design something so that it has a smooth shape that reduces resistance to air or water

synonyms.nuance_zh: 只强调“变得简单”，不含“提高效率、精简环节”的含义，可用于说明、解释等场景。
synonyms.collocation: simplify the application process（简化申请流程）

synonyms.nuance_zh: 更正式，多用于机构、产业重组，强调去掉重复与低效部分；英式拼写常作 rationalise。
synonyms.collocation: rationalise the workforce（精简员工队伍）

examples.sentence: The council streamlined its planning procedure, cutting the average waiting time from twelve weeks to four.
examples.translation_zh: 该委员会简化了规划审批程序，把平均等待时间从十二周缩短到四周。
examples.note_zh: 听力中常与 process、procedure、system 搭配，后接结果状语说明效率提升。

examples.sentence: Businesses often adopt new software in the hope of streamlining routine administration.
examples.translation_zh: 企业常常采用新软件，希望简化日常行政工作。
examples.note_zh: in the hope of doing sth 是写作中表达目的的常用结构，注意后接动名词。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读中的多义辨析词，需根据上下文判断是“数字平台”“站台”还是“表达渠道”；听力旅行场景常考 railway platform 的拼写。

senses.definition_en: a website or app that provides a service or allows users to share content
the flat area next to a railway track where passengers get on and off trains

senses.definition_zh: （表达观点、展示才能的）机会，渠道
senses.definition_en: an opportunity or medium for expressing ideas or showing talent

synonyms.nuance_zh: 范围更窄，特指汇集信息与入口的网站，不能泛指社交平台或表达机会。
synonyms.collocation: an online news portal（在线新闻门户）

synonyms.nuance_zh: 只对应“表达渠道”这一义项，强调释放想法或情绪，不能指数字平台或站台。
synonyms.collocation: an outlet for creative energy（释放创造力的途径）

collocations.meaning_zh: 为某人提供展示或表达的机会

examples.sentence: The survey found that most users under thirty get their news from social media platforms rather than newspapers.
examples.translation_zh: 调查发现，三十岁以下用户大多从社交媒体平台而非报纸获取新闻。
examples.note_zh: 此处 platform 指数字平台，阅读中要靠上下文排除“站台”义。

examples.sentence: The festival gives young musicians a platform to perform in front of a large audience.
examples.translation_zh: 这个音乐节为年轻音乐人提供了在大量观众面前演出的机会。
examples.note_zh: give sb a platform to do sth 可用于文化、教育类写作话题。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see that the library has replaced its old catalogue with an app?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I did. The idea is to streamline borrowing, but I couldn't work out how to renew a book.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's not exactly user-friendly. Still, those paper cards were becoming obsolete — half the entries were for books that had moved years ago.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. And once you get used to it, the search function is fast. The university says it wants to harness the data to see which subjects students actually borrow.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's the part that worries me. Once they start tracking borrowing habits, similar apps may proliferate across every department.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I doubt it. Most students just want a platform where they can check a due date in ten seconds.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Give it a month and we'll probably wonder how we ever managed without it.

quiz.question: In the sentence "Employers could harness automation to free staff from repetitive tasks", which option is closest in meaning to "harness"?
quiz.explanation_zh: harness 在此意为“利用（以取得好处）”，相当于 make practical use of。restrain 是“限制”，意思相反；其余两项与词义无关。

quiz.question: The report warns that the rapid ________ of unregulated apps may undermine public trust.
quiz.explanation_zh: 空格前有 the 和形容词 rapid，后接 of 短语，需要名词，故用 proliferation。proliferate 是动词，其余为分词形式，均不能作名词中心词。

review.question: In academic writing, what does "address" mean in "the report addresses the issue of youth unemployment"?
review.answer: Here "address" is a verb meaning to deal with or tackle a problem. It does not mean a postal address; the report discusses and tries to respond to the issue.

review.question: Give one synonym and one typical collocation for "incentive" as used in "tax incentives for electric cars".
review.answer: Synonym: motivation (or inducement). Collocation: provide / offer an incentive for sb to do sth. In this context an incentive is a financial or other reward that encourages a particular action.
